title: stelis toscanoi
intro: Stelis toscanoi, commonly known as the Tozcatl or Tozcatli, is a plant species in the orchid family that has been used in traditional medicine for various purposes. This plant has been reported to possess several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating conditions such as wounds, fever, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Stelis toscanoi include analgesic, antipyretic, and antiseptic properties, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
